newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria tenders for expansion of tractor factory.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders for expansion of tractor factory.

text.p: Syria's al-Frat company for manufacturing tractors and agricultural equipments has issued an international tender to expand its plant to produce 3,000 medium-sized tractors per year, officials said on Tuesday.
They said that April 30 was set as final date for receiving price bids which would be valid for six months.
A special committee will start looking at the bids on May 1, but no date has been set for the announcement of results.
Al-Frat, based in Aleppo, some 350 km (218 miles) north of Damascus, was established in 1974.
It currently produces 3,000 big-sized tractors per year. About 55 percent of the tractor parts are manufactured locally while the rest, including the engine, are imported.
